name: Six Senses Ibiza
positioning: Resort at Cala Xarraca on the northern tip of Ibiza, with pool suites, beachfront caves, large private residences and a farm learning center
best_for: Families and groups wanting a multi-bedroom residence with a private pool
Wellness travelers wanting a personalized program

facts.text: The resort is on the northern tip of Ibiza.
The resort's address is in Sant Joan de Labritja.
The resort is about a 35-minute drive from Ibiza's international airport.
The residences and mansions have private pools and offer services such as an in-villa chef, concierge and spa treatments.
The Learning Center is at Can Tanca, the resort's neighborhood farm.
Partal restaurant brings together Mediterranean, Moorish and Moroccan flavors.
Crafted experiences explore the north of Ibiza.
The resort's setting is meant for spiritual experiences rooted in local culture, celebrating music, art, sustainable fashion and wellness.

highlights.text: Accommodation includes guest rooms, residences, mansions, pool suites and beachfront caves.
The resort is set at Cala Xarraca.
The private residences and mansions range from three to ten bedrooms and suit families and groups.
The Farm Learning Center offers immersive experiences such as seed collection, yoga and seasonal harvesting.
Wellness experts create a personalized wellness program for each guest's needs.

considerations.text: The resort is on the island's northern tip, about a 35-minute drive from the airport.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to the town center.
